question: Do the UBR3-WT best-hit half-lives reproduce in independent datasets?

datasets.Yi2023: in-extract degradation 0-15 h; half-lives derived by us
datasets.Li2021: cycloheximide chase in living cells 0-8 h; ['HEK293T', 'U2OS', 'HCT116', 'RPE1']; Table S2 lists only proteins losing >15% at 8 h with R2>0.8
datasets.Mathieson2018: dynamic SILAC, 4 human primary cell types (mouse neurons excluded)

Li2021_HEK293T.expected_sign: negative for k (faster decay = shorter half-life), positive for 15h remaining

Mathieson2018_primary_cells.expected_sign: negative for k (faster decay = shorter half-life), positive for 15h remaining

caveat: Absence from Li Table S2 means the protein either was not degraded >15% in 8 h or was not quantified; Table S1 is needed to separate those. Do not read absence as proof of stability.
